culture.label: Lugha na eneo la kiolesura
culture.hint: Hudhibiti kiolesura cha JobLens na lugha ya majibu ya Claude. Tafuta kwa lugha, nchi, au msimbo. Otomatiki hufuata kivinjari na hutumia Kiingereza cha Marekani ikiwa hakuna mechi.

preflight.modeLabel: Ukaguzi wa awali wa vichujio vikali
preflight.modeHint: Speedy skip signals before a full Scan. Uses Haiku (no extended thinking) regardless of the Scan model above. Auto checks listings as you open them; Hybrid waits for Quick check to spend Haiku tokens.

options.apiKeyNoteLong: Stored only in this browser profile and sent directly to the Anthropic API. Anyone with access to the profile can read it — use a dedicated key with limits.
options.modelStale: Previous model {{model}} is not in the current list; Sonnet 5 is selected. Save to persist.
options.geoHint: Required for Scan — set at least one of: a commute ZIP, remote-eligible regions, or Remote only. Without geography intent, scanning is blocked.
options.remoteOnly: Remote only — skip onsite and hybrid roles
options.importHint: Pakia wasifu au maelezo (.txt, .md, .pdf, .docx). JobLens inapendekeza mabadiliko; hakiki na utumie kwenye rasimu, kisha Hifadhi.
options.educationCustom: Thamani maalum kwenye faili: {{value}}. Chagua kipengele cha orodha kuchukua nafasi.
options.geoRemoteOnlyHint: Radi za ZIP ni hiari wakati Remote tu. Mikoa bado husaidia kazi za remote zenye vikwazo vya makazi.
options.geoZipHint: Ongeza kila ZIP unayoweza kusafiri kwenda kwa ukaguzi wa onsite/hybrid.
options.travelHint: Ikiwa imewekwa, majukumu ya remote / hybrid nyepesi yanayohitaji ziara hadi mara hii hupata Soft concern badala ya Hard skip nje ya radi zako.
options.regionsLabel: Unapotoka kufanya kazi kwa majukumu ya remote (majimbo ya Marekani yaliyotenganishwa kwa koma, mf. CA, NY)
options.regionsHint: Kichujio cha makazi kwa kazi za remote tu — si miji ya kusafiri.
options.relocationFlag: Weka alama uhamisho nje ya miji yangu bila lugha ya ruzuku
options.skillsHint: Inapendekezwa sana kwa Fit/Apply ya kuaminika. Held = ukweli; Ramp = sehemu; Never-claim = kutolingana ikiwa inahitajika.
options.employmentPriorityHint: Kipaumbele cha ajira (weka alama kujumuisha; mishale kupanga).
options.minContractMonths: Urefu wa chini wa mkataba (miezi, hiari)
options.skipTriggers: Vichochezi vya skip maalum (moja kwa mstari)
options.flagPerm: Weka alama arifa za cheti cha PERM
options.payUseFloors: Ruka kazi nje ya min–max yangu
options.payFloorsHint: Min/max hutumika tu unapochagua “Ruka kazi nje ya min–max yangu”.
options.flagSuspiciousComp: Weka alama malipo ya kutiliwa shaka dhidi ya soko (rationale tu)
options.preferStructured: Pendelea lugha ya JD iliyopangwa / uwajibikaji wa juu
options.pipelineLoad: Bomba lako la maombi limejaa kiasi gani?

options.roleSkipHint: Skip za aina ya jukumu (zote zimelazimishwa kwa chaguo-msingi).

options.skipUnverifiableHint: Weka alama waajiri wasio na uwepo wazi wa wavuti.
